correctness.rationale: Exact transfer-current covariance follows from the determinant formula. The twisted massive Green kernel solves an explicit recurrence; Fourier characters split the 3n variables into n scalar odd modes and n Hermitian 2 by 2 blocks. The rank-one covariance kernel follows from edge exchanges along overlapping four-cycles. Symbolic algebra establishes the constant upper limiting branch, the positive lower branch, and a uniform nonzero spectral gap; first-order perturbation with rim weight at least 2/3 proves the 1/(3n) bottom eigenvalue and sqrt(3)/2 condition coefficient. Direct covariance calculations and exact spanning-tree enumeration through n=6, plus independent symbolic identities, passed; finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The Moebius ladder is the natural nonorientable two-rail cyclic graph. Exact Fourier blocks provide quantitative first-order observation geometry of the uniform spanning-tree polytope; the novel sharp linear stability degradation contrasts structurally with quadratic deterioration on wheels. The 1/(3n) soft mode is a substantive, infinite-family spectral boundary mechanism rather than arbitrary finite enumeration.
